pages.text: Where a road crosses the line, put a $(item)Level Crossing$() at the side of the road, within three blocks of the track: its arm comes down towards you, across the road. Click the post to set how far the arm reaches (one to eight blocks).$(br2)Real crossings have one each side of the line.

When a train is due within ten seconds, the lamps flash and the bell rings; then the arm comes down, and stays down while any of a train is on the crossing. Under it, an unseen barrier stops cars getting through.$(br2)It gives a redstone signal while it's warning, for your own lamps or bells.
The lamps flash and the arms are down.
